description: Composes the whole enrichment stage as one pure function (bundle + catalog + params -> enriched frame + tag rows), for direct unit testing from fixtures without touching the database.
signature: def build_enriched_frame(bundle: RawBundle, catalog: pd.DataFrame, params: EnrichmentParams) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[TagRow]]
docstring:
Run the full enrichment transformation in memory.

Args:
    bundle: parse_raw_bundle's output.
    catalog: The full bulk catalog frame (acquisition.build_catalog_frame's output for the whole run), needed by compute_developer_catalog_size.
    params: EnrichmentParams.

Returns:
    (enriched_frame, tag_rows): enriched_frame has exactly the columns games_enriched expects (see 01_storage.module_spec.json), including complexity_score, estimated_sales_low/mid/high, estimated_revenue_gross_usd/net_usd, effort_adjusted_return, imputed_features_json, and parameters_version is NOT set here (it is stamped by run_enrichment, the caller, since this pure function has no knowledge of which parameters.toml hash produced params). tag_rows is extract_tags' output.

Pipeline order: normalize_features -> extract_tags -> compute_developer_catalog_size (merged into the frame) -> drop non-game rows (counted) -> map_genre_bucket -> compute_complexity_score -> estimate_sales -> estimate_revenue -> compute_effort_adjusted_return -> assemble final column set.

Row-dropping: rows where is_game is False (from normalize_features) are removed from the returned enriched_frame entirely (the enrichment module's invariant: 'Rows whose app_type is not game are dropped and counted, not silently included') -- the drop count and reason are NOT returned by this pure function itself (it has no report object), but ARE computed and returned by run_enrichment, which calls this function and then separately tallies len(bundle.steamspy) - len(enriched_frame) attributable to app_type.
preconditions: catalog contains every appid referenced in bundle.steamspy (should hold trivially since bundle.steamspy IS effectively a re-read of the same underlying raw_games rows catalog was built from)
postconditions: Calling build_enriched_frame twice with identical (bundle, catalog, params) produces byte-identical output frames (the stage's own idempotence invariant, tested at this pure-function level rather than only at the run_enrichment/storage level)
Every row in the output has app_type == 'game'

edge_cases.input: bundle with zero appids (empty candidate set)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty enriched_frame with the full column set and an empty tag_rows list, per 'Empty candidate set (candidate_count == 0) -> stage succeeds writing zero rows'

edge_cases.input: Every candidate has app_type != 'game' (e.g. the coarse filter's review-count-based band happened to admit only DLC entries -- a real, if narrow, scenario)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty enriched_frame; not an error

unit_tests.name: test_idempotent_across_two_calls
unit_tests.description: Two consecutive calls with the same fixture inputs produce identical DataFrames, per the module's own testing requirement.

unit_tests.name: test_non_game_rows_dropped
unit_tests.description: A bundle containing one dlc-type appid alongside game-type appids excludes the dlc row from the output.

unit_tests.name: test_integration_against_fixture_matches_expected_csv
unit_tests.description: tests/fixtures/raw_bundle_small.json processed end-to-end matches tests/fixtures/expected_enriched_small.csv exactly, per the module's own integration test.
unit_tests.expected: frame equals the expected fixture CSV
